characters.name: In General
characters.description: Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: The Nohara family would always bicker with and annoy each other at every opportunity they can get. They're also quite selfish on getting what they want without thinking of other people's concern. Though at the end of the day, they would make peace with each other and then going back to being a happy family, after all the conflict they went through has been resolved. Badass Family: Generally, all of them have awesome moments in the main series, but this feature is more prominent in the non-canonical special episodes and movies. Beware the Silly Ones: They may look like aDysfunctional Familywho annoy each other with their silly antics and cause trouble to other people, but when push comes to shove, theycanbecome a force to be reckoned with and will not hesitate to fight back, as manyantagonistsfrom animated movies find out the hard way. Determinator: A prominent trait of all of them is that they wouldn't stop no matter what in order to fulfill their goals. Dysfunctional Family: They're a family who often fights over petty things, lust towards other people outside the family, and is prone to physical violence towards each other. Despite this, they all love and support themselves.

characters.name: Shinnosuke Nohara (Shin)
characters.description: Animal Disguise: He is often seen dressed as various animals for the sake of a gag. This is expanded in the videogames, where he changes his playstyle to match the animal outfit he's going to use. Ascended Fanboy: In the movies where Action Mask plays a role, he often plays the role of his sidekick and even joins in defeating the villain. Big Brother Instinct: Towards Himawari, especially in the movies. Bratty Half-Pint: No matter the situation, Shin will always whine to his mom in order for her to give into his negotiation. Character Tics: He has an obsession with pulling down his pants to reveal his buttocks and genitals.

characters.name: Hiroshi Nohara (Hiro)
characters.description: The Alcoholic: He often comes home late at night drunk. Berserk Button: He really doesn't like others freeloading off him and his family. Butt-Monkey: Poor Hiroshi is the biggest victim of this trope in the entire series, with every single misfortune coming to his way in one way or another. He is the biggest recipient of getting the wrong end ofDomestic Abusefrom his wife Misae, which Shin-chan and Himawari always redirecting their faults toward him and suffers for them. Henpecked Husband: Hiroshi is Misae's bitch. Hero of Another Story: Hiroshi is the protagonist of aspin-off mangacalled"The Style of Hiroshi Nohara's Lunch"where he goes to different kinds of dining establishments in Kasukabe during his lunch break and commenting on howappetizinganddelicioushis lunch is.

characters.name: Misae Nohara (Mitzi)
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Of theCorporal Punishmenttype towards Shinnosuke, as she's often prone to hit him hard with her fist if he sets her off. Averted with Himawari, who is more lenient due to her being a baby. A-Cup Angst: His son often makes jokes about her flat chest. The Funimation dub has a running gag where she's saving up for a boob job. Ass Kicks You: Does this constantly throughout the series, she oftens bumps or even crushes Hiro and Shin with her Butt if they misbehave or annoy her in someway. Became Their Own Antithesis: Before Shinnosuke was born, she was against punishing children with brutal force. Five years later... Berserk Button:She doesn't like Hiroshi and Shinnosuke hitting on other women. She goes easier on Shin-chan due to being her own son and due to his young age, but she doesn't give her husband Hiroshi any sort of mercy when caught.Also, don't say she has a fat belly, old, or that she is flat-chested in front of her, much less all of them combined.

characters.name: Himawari Nohara (Hima)
characters.description: Baby Talk: She only displayed this on the special episodes. Baby See, Baby Do: Much to Misae's dismay, she is mimicking and developing the worst traits of her family, especially from her and her older brother Shin-chan. The Baby of the Bunch: She's the youngest member of the Nohara family. She did not appear at the beginning of the show, and there was an episode where she was born. Brainy Baby: She's quite intelligent for an infant. Dirty Kid: Despite her still being a baby, she has developed a taste for young adult men.

characters.name: Shiro (Whitey)
characters.description: Abandoned Pet in a Box: In his debut appearance, Shinnosuke and his friends found him like this. Butt-Monkey: His master Shinnosuke often forgot his meals or neglects his daily walks. Canine Companion: For the entire Nohara family, especially Shinnosuke Canine Loyalty: No matter how much Shinnosuke forgets feeding him or taking him to walks, he will always be loyal towards the Nohara Family.This also extends to his original family, as he doesn't resent her original owner Run for abandoning him to save his life, smiling at her when she discovers by causality where Shiro lives now. This also extends to his original family, as he doesn't resent her original owner Run for abandoning him to save his life, smiling at her when she discovers by causality where Shiro lives now.

characters.name: Toru Kazama (Georgie Prescott)
characters.description: Accidental Kiss: He has experienced this withShinnosukeof all people. Child Prodigy: Kazama is seen as this by her mother. Though it's somewhatdownplayedsince he receives extra tuition classes afterschool which his mother enrolls him to gain more academic knowledge than any other students who don't have the privileges that he has. Closet Geek: He is a closeted fanboy of magical girl shojo anime shows like Mysterious Magical Girl Mari-chan and Moe-P. Though he promptly denies about his interests in them when asked by his friends. Deadpan Snarker: Been around with a group of friends whereShin-chanis in for a long time, it's not hard to see why Kazama develops this trait in dealing with his antics. Every time Shin-chan did or said something stupid, Kazama would quip back at him with biting sarcasm, even though it always flies over Shin-chan's head, much to his annoyance. Disappeared Dad: Subverted. The early issues of the manga repeatedly features the parents of all five save for Kazama, where only his mother is mentioned - leading to implications that Kazama is from a single-parent family. Turns out that's not the case, in one of the late, late issues (episode692of the anime) Kazama's father is mentioned for the first time, revealed to be working in Australia all the while.

characters.name: Masao Sato (Maso)
characters.description: Henpecked Husband: He always plays this role during Nene's twisted tea parties. Hopeless Suitor: He is in love with Ai-chan, but she is more interested in Shinnosuke. Otaku: He is a huge fan of the Fubukimaru manga, and wants to become a mangaka like his favorite author Usuto Yoshii. Prone to Tears: Masao is the most sensible member of the group and is often seen crying.

characters.name: Bo Suzuki (Boo)
characters.description: Ambiguously Absent Parent: His parents never appeared in the anime. They only appeared a few times in the manga, but their appearances were always censored. Collector of the Strange: Boo likes to collect rocks with strange shapes. Pokémon Speak: In the Vitello and Phuuz English dubs, he sometimes says his own name. The Quiet One: He doesn't talk as much as the other members. Smarter Than You Look: Despite his silly looks, he has proven to have huge knowledge about ufos

characters.name: Nene Sakurada (Penny Milfer)
characters.description: Clingy Jealous Girl: She gets jealous of Ai-chan whenever she flirts with Shin and when Masao tries to gain the rich girl's attention.< The Dreaded: Every other member of the Kasukabe Defence Force is afraid of her due to her bossy attitude and her habit of forcing them to play her twisted tea parties. Hair-Trigger Temper: In the later episodes of the series, she inherits her mother's temper and starts punching her stuffed rabbit when she gets mad. Jerkass to One: She's pretty awful to the other members of the Kasukabe Defence Force, but she's especially mean towards Masao, treating him like her bitch and giving him the most humiliating roles on her tea parties. Like Mother, Like Daughter: Like her mother, she punches a giant rabbit plush when she becomes pissed, but unlike her, she has displayed doing it publicly.

characters.name: Moeko Sakurada (Patty Milfer)
characters.description: Berserk Button: She's despises Shinnosuke critiquing her food and labeling it as too salty, even more so when the brat takes the food without being given consent from her. Black Comedy Rape: One of the running gags is that her husband rapes her consistently. Housewife: She stays in home and cares for Nene, while her husband works. Like Mother, Like Daughter: When frustrated, she punches a giant rabbit plush when she becomes pissed, but unlike her, she has displayed doing it publicly. Stepford Smiler: She makes a superhuman effort to retain her composure whenever Shin-chan is around, as she doesn't want her daughter to pick up her worst traits, and politely excuses herself to privately beat her stuffed rabbit when she's about to lose it.

characters.name: Ginnosuke Nohara
characters.description: Cool Old Guy: Despite his age, he can keep up with the new trends of the world and knows how to have a good time with his grandson. Dirty Old Man: Like Shinnosuke, he enjoys looking at pretty young women, much to his wife's dismay. Dub Name Change: In the Korean dub, his name is changed into Shin Dolsik (신돌식). The name is mentioned in some episodes' Korean dub and quite similar to Shin Yeongsik, which is one of Hiroshi's Korean dub names. Foil: Serves as this to Yoshiji Koyama, as he's open-minded, a bit childish, and is bald. Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow: As shown in Hiroshi's memories in the Adult empire strikes back movie, he used to have short black hair when Hiroshi was a kid.

characters.name: Tsuru Nohara
characters.description: Cool Old Guy: Like her husband, she can keep up with the new trends of the world and knows how to have a good time with his grandson.

characters.name: Semashi Nohara
characters.description: Adaptational Late Appearance: He didn't appear in the anime until he finally appeared in the special episode "It's time! Semashi Nohara is here!"(野原せまし登場!だゾ), which was made during the 30th anniversary of the franchise. Foil: To his younger brother, unlike him, decided to work as a farmer instead of being a salaryman, doesn't have Hiroshi's infamous smelly feet, and is still single. Later, he manages to marry a woman called Ikuna who had children before. Meaningful Name: His name Semashi literally means stingy, as he's a miser who avoids spending money. The Stoic: Unlike his younger brother, he rarely expresses any emotions.

characters.name: Yoshiji Koyama
characters.description: Foil: Serves as this to Ginnosuke, as he's serious, mature, and still has hair on his head The Rival: Due to their clashing personalities, he is often seen antagonizing Ginnosuke. Not So Above It All: Despite being the most serious relative of the Noharas, he can sometimes lose his composture while competing against Ginnosuke.

characters.name: Masae Koyama
characters.description: Cool Mask: During the times she visits the Noharas, she always introduces herself by wearing one just for the sake of scaring Misae. The Gadfly: She likes to tease her younger sister Misae, a trait that she never grow out out it. Laser-Guided Karma: After scaring Misae, she is often scared by Shinnosuke's weirder masks when she tries to prank him. Kimono Is Traditional: Unlike her younger sisters who wear simpler and more casual clothes, she prefers to wear kimonos. The Prankster: She loves pranking people, especially her younger sister Misae.

characters.name: Musae Koyama
characters.description: Annoying Younger Sibling: She's the youngest of Misae's sister. Lazy Bum: During her stay at the Nohara's household, she barely did the bare minimum. Put on a Bus: Her role in the series is significantly reduced after she gets a new job as a photographer and moves to Matazuresou.

characters.name: Bunta Takakura (Bernoulli Ench)
characters.description: Badass Teacher: He is very protective about the students attending his kindergarten, and is willing to take advantage of his scary yakuza face if someone makes the mistake of threatening his students. Cool Car: His bus, which is modeled to resemble a pink cat with cat ears at the top of the bus. The Driver: He server as the driver to every children in his kindergarten, driving the school bus. Face of a Thug: He is often mistaken as a yakuza due to his scary face. And even when he clarifies that he's the principal, people just think that means he's the warden of a prison instead Happily Married: He is married with Mrs. Takakura, who works with him as the owners of the kindergarten.

characters.name: Midori Ishizaka (Miss Anderson)
characters.description: Friendly Rivalry: She often competes with Ume Matsuzaka, this being more prominently in sports and competition events. Foil: She's a foil of Ume Matsuzaka. At the beggining of the series, both women start as single young women looking for love. However, while Matsuzaka's abrassive personality makes it hard to find any potential suitor, with her only serious relationship Tokuro either rejecting her for Good after moving to Australia in the anime orbeing killed in a terrorist attackand struggles finantially due to prioritizing spending her paycheck in expensive dresses to look good for potential suitors, Midori's calmer personality manages to get herself married to Ishizaka for good and finding stability in her home. Happily Married: She marries Ishizaka late in the series Reasonable Authority Figure: In contrast to Matsusaka and Ageo, she seems to be more down to the earth. Stern Teacher: She is this towards shin chan, due to how hard is to control him.

characters.name: Ume Matsuzaka (Miss Katz)
characters.description: Conspicuous Consumption: She often wastes her money in pretty expensive dresses, forcing her to spend the rest of the month feeding herself with cheap food. Do Not Call Me "Paul": She dislikes her given name due to one of the meanings of "Ume", refering it to something of "3rd class" or "low class" Drowning My Sorrows: Ume often gets drunk when she's rejected. Everyone Has Standards: As much as desperate she is in her search for a date, she doesn't seek to want any relationship with a suitor who is mean towards children, acts like a manchild or both. Failure Is the Only Option: Expect this during the episodes where he dates men.

characters.name: Masumi Ageo (Miss Polly)
characters.description: Badass Teacher: Normally, she struggles to face her students, but in her debut episode, she defends her students from an adult hooligan who threatened them, becoming scary when he makes the mistake to push her off, removing her glasses and revealing her aggresive personality. Brutal Honesty: Without her glasses, she aggressively says what she thinks without any filter. Hidden Depths: In one episode, she is shown to have great computing knowledge and even managed to create her own internet webpage. Shrinking Violet: With her glasses, she is very shy and has trouble dealing with the kids. Split Personality: Her personality depends. She's totally frightened and shy while she wears them, but if her glasses are removed, she becomes aggressive and fearless.

characters.name: Reiko Kitamoto
characters.description: Adaptation Name Change: She's named Ms. Goobers in the Vitello, Phuuz and Dutch dubs, and Yuka in the Funimation dub. Food as Bribe: When Shinnosuke visits her house, she always give him sweets and cakes in exchange for his family's embarrassing moments so she can gossip them. Gossipy Hens: She often gossips about the people around the neighborhood, Misae included. Hidden Depths: In one episode where her distant nephew Robert is staying over in her house temporarily from overseas, Reiko is exceptionally fluent in English language flawlessly when speaking with him at one point, much to Misae's surprise after she heard their conversations once. Given how extremely difficult English language is for majority of Japanese people to learn, let alone fully mastered it, it's not hard to see why Misae is so shocked about this revelation. Sorry to Interrupt: Much to the dismay of Misae, she always come at an inappropriate time, giving her something to gossip against them.

characters.name: Micchi and Yoshirin Hatogaya
characters.description: Adaptation Name Change: Mitchi is known as Gidgy and Yoshirin is known as Luis in the Vitello, Phuuz and Dutch dubs. Drop-In Character: They're often seen inviting themselves to the Nohara's house, principally to get advice with their marital troubles. Misae and especially Hiro hate it, though Shin and Hima don't mind for the most part. Iconic Outfit: Both Micchi and Yoshirin are always shown to be wearing green t-shirts/sweaters with a pink heart in the middle. Intergenerational Friendship: Both get along pretty well with the Nohara children. Manchild: Both of them. They fight about minor things and need the Noharas to help them. Ends up being a literal case in an episode where Yoshirin devolves into the mentality of a child, wanting his "nanny".

characters.name: Nanako Ohara
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: While in the manga she's a brunette, in the anime she has black hair. Heterosexual Life-Partners: She's currently living with her best friend, Shinobu Kandadori. Helicopter Parents: Nanako's father Shijuro is extremely overprotective of his daughter and often worries too much about her, despite loving her very much. One of the comic stories has Nanako thinking she's being followed by a stalker only to find out that's actually a private investigator Shijuro hired to keep tabs on Nanako; another story had Nanako taking a part-time job at a sushi restaurant, only for Shijuro to spend literally half a day in said restaurant (eating over 100 plates of sushi in a row) to watch his daughter at work. Morality Chain: She's this to Shinnosuke, as he tries to behave himself when she's present. Nice Girl: Established in the first episode she appeared, as she helped Shin-chan.

characters.name: Shinobu Kandadori
characters.description: Abhorrent Admirer: She likes to hug Shinnosuke, much to his dismay. Adaptation Name Change: She's known as Griselda in the Funimation dub. Heterosexual Life-Partners: She's currently living with her best friend, Nanako Ohara. Nice Girl: Established in the first episode she appeared, as she helped Shin-chan. Wrestler in All of Us: She wants to become a professional wrestler.

characters.name: Tokuro Gyoda
characters.description: Adapted Out: His tragic sudden death in the manga hasn't been adapted on the anime yet. Dropped a Bridge on Him: In the volume 47 of the manga, just as he was to return to Kasukabe he becomes a fatal victim of a terrorist attack in Africa at the hotel he was residing. Spared by the Adaptation: He will continue to be alive in the anime, as long as the anime doesn't adapt his tragic fate on the manga.

characters.name: Fumie Nogamigawa
characters.description: Berserk Button: She has three, which are being compared to Mimiko Sakura from Action Kamen, being told that she doesn't look like Fumie Nakajima and being asked what's the third thing that annoys her immediately after learning her two previous berserk buttons. Gone Horribly Right: During one occasion where she babysat Shin, she decided to play the role of her big sister and make him more obedient, but backfires hardly when she's forced to take the responsibility for all the mischief Shinnosuke makes around the neighborhood. Put on a Bus: Her character disappeared after Himawari was born.

characters.name: Junichi Ishizaka
characters.description: Accidental Kiss: Gives one to a sleepwalking Shin, thinking it was his wife wanting to have sex with him. Both parties wake up after the kiss andrealize what's really happening. Dub Name Change: Doyle in the Funimation dub. Friend to All Children: He gets along pretty well with Shin and his gang, unlike his wife. Happily Married: He's pretty happy being with Yoshinaga all things considered. Nice Guy: He's a genuinely mellow guy who has patience with all the weirdness around him.

characters.name: Nushiyo Ooya
characters.description: Berserk Button: Noise, especially if it makes her dentures tower fall.Don't break anything on his apartment Don't break anything on his apartment Cranky Landlord: Towards the Nohara family, as she lives under them and they're the most noisy neighbors of the apartments. Dark and Troubled Past: Her husband and her 3 years old daughter died tragically 30 years ago prior to the events on the series. The Nose Knows: She can immediately detect if a dog comes inside her apartments just with the scent of the dog alone.

characters.name: Yonroh
characters.description: Gonk: He's overweight and has glasses. Hikikomori: Rarely leaves his apartment, unless it's to mooch off the Noharas during meal times. Intergenerational Friendship: Yonro gets along pretty well with Shin. After Shin has him as a tutor for a while, he quickly finds a way to make learning enjoyable. Only One Name: Yonro's surname has never been revealed. Rōnin: Until the Nohara's arrived, he failed his entrance tests three years in a row.

characters.name: Atsuko and Atsumi Kutsuzoko
characters.description: Gyaru Girl: Atsuko is often wearing super short skirts, loose socks, and platform shoes. Teen Pregnancy: When the Nohara's first meet her, she's 18 and her daughter Atsumi is only two years old. When You Coming Home, Dad?: Atsumi's father, Atsushi Kutsuzoko is never seen on the series, due to working as a truck driver.

characters.name: Action Mask (Action Bastard)
characters.description: Action Hero: His name isn't action for nothing. Affectionate Parody: TowardsToku-basedsuperheroes in general, mostlyKamen RiderandUltraman. Cool Mask: He wears a cool blue mask with spinky horns, a spiky red stripe and yellow eye glasses. Living a Double Life: In his civilian identity as Gotarō Gō, he works as a stuntman for the film industry. Signature Move: His most used move is the Action Beam, and powered up variants of it.

characters.name: Mimiko Sakura (Loli Pop)
characters.description: Damsel in Distress: She is often kidnapped by theMonster of the Week, needing the help of Action Mask to be saved. Hyper-Competent Sidekick: She often aids Action mask with valuable information and gadgets that will help him defeat his enemies even when kidnapped.

characters.name: Kantam Robot
characters.description: Signature Move: His most used move is detaching his arms.

characters.name: Mari-chan
characters.description: Amnesia Loop: Due to Shila always revealing her true identity, which she needs to keep secret in order to pass her magical schooling, she is forced to wipe out everybody's memories of her in most of the episodes. Failure Is the Only Option: No matter how much she integrates into her class, at the end of the episode she will have to erase the witnesses' memories about her due to Shila always outing her true identity, therefore having to be reintroduced as a new student again. Magical Girl: She comes from a world of mages. Secret Identity: She needs to keep her true identity secret as is one of the requirements she has in order to pass her class.

characters.name: Shila
characters.description: Beauty Is Bad: When she fights against Mari-chan she is shown wearing a skimpy sexy dress. This trait is one of the reasons why Shinnosuke and Hiroshi root for her sometimes. Evil Redhead: She changes her hair from brown to purple as she transforms into her magical self The Rival: To Mari-chan. Villain Reveals the Secret: In every episode of the show, she manages to forcefully reveal Mari-chan's secret identity to her classroom, forcing the protagonist to erase their memories and start over again.

characters.name: Moe-P
characters.description: Magical Girl: She comes from a magical world. Medium Awareness: In one of the episodes, she is shown to be aware that they're doing scenes in the bathroom in order to increase ratings, only to toss it aside when Hazuki asks what she meant by it.

characters.name: Dr. Wienstien/Happiness Bunny
characters.description: Dub Name Change: While the original Japanese dub nicknamed him "Usagi-chan", the Vitello/Phuuz dub named him "Dr. Wienstein" (alongside with the other stuffed bunnies treated like punching bags). The Funimation dub named him "Happiness Bunny". Early-Bird Cameo: Believe it or not, there are stuffed bunny characters Nini owns that look very similar to the Happiness Bunny prior to his actual first appearance. Percussive Therapy: He is well-known for getting beat up by Nene and her mom almost every time they're angry.

characters.name: Buriburizaemon (Ham Solo)
characters.description: Adaptational Villainy: In some specials, he represents the role of the villain. Anti-Hero: Despite Shinnosuke claiming that Buriburizaemon is a hero, his personality is pretty antiheroic at best. Berserk Button: He despises to be called a pig, despite being one himself. Demoted to Extra: His role in the anime dropped significantly after the death of his seiyuu Kaneto Shiozawa in the year 2000, only using him for non-speaking cameos until 2016 when he got a new voice. Dub Name Change: His first appearance in the Funimation Dub (Shin Wars) leads to him being referred to as Ham Solo for the rest of the show.

characters.name: Duyaggo Eraindesu
characters.description: The mayor of Madakueruyobaka. He has attempted to revitalize the city by drawing many tourists and companies with the discovery of the special cactus.

characters.name: Nene Rodriguez / Rainbow Kamen
characters.description: Cowardly Lion: Despite his tough guy image and profession, he's afraid of fighting - often faking injuries to get out of it. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass

characters.name: Carolina
characters.description: Action Girl: She's a very acrobatic and skilled fighter, easily fighting off several cacti with ease. Never Trust a Trailer: Some trailers feature a scene of Shinnosuke and her dancing in the town square. Said scene does not appear in the film and it's difficult to place exactly where in the film that moment was meant to be taking place. Hot for Teacher: Naturally, Shinnosuke becomes smitten with her. Impossible Hourglass Figure: She is very well-endowed, which of course only increases Shin's infatuation with her. Ms. Fanservice:ABSOLUTELY!
